posts.content_md:
I know that thge volume holograms used for memory storage typically us photorefractive crystals where intense light shapes the internal refractive index through storing space-sharge fields in the dark fringes, but that isn't what I'm interested in.

 I'm wondering if anything interesting can be done in holography with refractive modulation at a few thousandths or tens of thousandths of the index. My first instinct is to guess that chromatic patterning rather than wavefront formation would be something to look at since you could use the light frequency to create grating patterns that were more tightly packed.

 Ideas, anyone?
